name: rulake-core
description: The eight rulake_* MCP tools (query, list_backends, list_collections, publish_bundle, refresh_from_bundle_dir, save_cache_to_dir, warm_from_dir, invalidate_cache), the /rulake-query decision-layer skill, and the /rulake-discover advisory tool that recommends which other ruLake plugin to install for a given goal. Wires to the live Cloud Run demo by default; switch to stdio for production.
